selections.speaker: The risen Jesus and the disciples, in dialogue
selections.note: The risen Jesus tells the disciples to minister in a direct and narrow way; Matthew 7:13–14 and Luke 13:24 use related but different imagery. James’s translation uses Coptic and Ethiopic witnesses; the hosted paragraph does not specify a sole witness.

selections.speaker: The risen Jesus, as reported by the disciples
selections.note: The text’s risen Jesus describes Saul as a chosen vessel and an enduring wall. After six Coptic leaves are marked lost, James continues from Ethiopic witnesses; the complete paragraph preserves an Ethiopic manuscript variant.
proposals: Retain the full chapter-31 paragraph, including James’s parenthetical Ethiopian variant; check precise witness coverage against the edition.

selections.speaker: The risen Jesus and the disciples, in dialogue
selections.note: In James’s text the Coptic witness is defective from chapter 48; this later passage follows the Ethiopic continuation. The risen Jesus speaks here; John the Baptist speaks in Matthew 3:12 and Luke 3:17.
